sections.title: Trial class: €60
paragraphs: One trial class of 60 minutes. Call us or write us an email to arrange your class.

sections.title: What to expect
list: Beginners are best off starting with level 1 or basic classes.
Bring a water bottle and a small towel. If you have a yoga mat, feel free to bring it, otherwise you can use our studio mats.
Arrive 5 to 15 minutes before the start so you can settle in.
Wear comfortable clothes you can move in. You do not need shoes.
Please let me know before class about injuries, pregnancy or medical problems.

sections.title: Collect your yoga moments.
sections.text: The small YogaCard helps you keep track of the classes you have completed. It also reminds you of your yoga moments at home. You receive it when you register.
